name: SMB service permits null-session enumeration
description: The SMB endpoint accepts an anonymous (null) session and returns a non-empty share enumeration. Microsoft KB 246261 and CIS Windows benchmarks both require the RestrictAnonymous registry value to forbid null-session share enumeration; an exposed enumeration leaks share names and ACL hints. (Phase D runtime executes this rule once the SMB probe ships — schema-only today.)
